summary:
甲骨文最新季度營收與獲利雙雙超越市場預期，受惠於雲端運算業務的強勁增長與AI基礎設施需求的推動。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）為 1.92 美元，優於預期的 1.74 美元。
• 總營收達 19.18 億美元，年增率高達 20.63%。
• 雲端基礎設施與應用服務需求強勁，成為核心成長引擎。
• 獲利能力的提升展現了良好的營運效率與規模經濟。
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報展現強勁的雲端轉型成果與 AI 獲利能力，對中短期股價具備正向支撐。後續應持續追蹤雲端剩餘履約價值（RPO）的成長速度以及資本支出的投報率。

需留意：全球總體經濟環境不確定性可能影響企業 IT 支出預算。；雲端市場競爭激烈，來自大型同業的價格與技術壓力持續存在。

summary_en:
Oracle reported stronger-than-expected quarterly revenue and earnings, driven by robust cloud computing growth and high demand for AI infrastructure.
• EPS came in at $1.92, beating the estimated $1.74.
• Total revenue reached $19.18 billion, representing a 20.63% year-over-year increase.
• Strong demand for cloud infrastructure and applications served as the core growth driver.
• Improved profitability demonstrated solid operating efficiency and economies of scale.

view: Signal is positive, reflecting successful cloud transformation and AI monetization, supporting near-to-mid-term stock performance. Track remaining performance obligations (RPO) growth and capital expenditure ROI.

Watch：Global macroeconomic uncertainties could impact enterprise IT spending budgets.; Intense competition in the cloud market presents ongoing pricing and technological pressures from major peers.
